5f5be6069eeca344863dd557.text: {"headline":"Council approves paving contract for Palmetto Park Road","dek":"The work begins Nov. 2 and is expected to take six weeks.","body_md":"The Boca Raton City Council voted 4-1 on Tuesday to approve a $2,500,000 contract with Acme Paving to resurface Palmetto Park Road.\n\nWork begins Nov. 2 and is expected to take six weeks, the city said.","beat":"government","source_record_ids":["ad14998e-1555-42d1-8f9a-b8a673e5b4cb"],"claims":[{"text":"The council voted 4-1.","record_id":"ad14998e-1555-42d1-8f9a-b8a673e5b4cb"}]}

{"headline":"How bulk trash pickup works in Boca Raton","dek":"What the city collects, and what a paid pickup costs.","body_md":"## Collection
Bulk items are collected from single-family residences once a week.

## Paid pickups
A minimum fee of $161.71 will be charged for items measuring up to 2 cubic yards. Call the Sanitation Department at 561-416-3367.","source_record_ids":["ce27c525-6fff-4362-8570-4b4b2abf784e"],"claims":[]}
